title: Mailroom Schedule: Envelope Charge on Vehicle Amendments, Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing
content:
The vehicle-amendment envelope charge follows how the Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate travels to the state and whether the filing's record shows a reinstatement transmission sent today.

| Certificate travels by | Reinstatement transmission of the filing sent today | Vehicle-amendment envelope charge |
|---|---|---|
| Paper mail | Yes — the amendment rides in the envelope of that reinstatement transmission | 1.25 (enclosure) |
| Paper mail | No | 9.85 (certified mail) |
| Electronic transmission | Either | None |

How a certificate travels is the transmission method in its timetable. "Sent today" means a reinstatement transmission on the filing's record whose transmission date is today's date; a reinstatement transmission sent on an earlier day does not count.

## Hypothetical cases

- A paper-mail certificate whose record shows a reinstatement transmission dated today: 1.25.
- The same certificate whose latest reinstatement transmission is dated last week: 9.85.
- An electronically transmitted certificate, with or without a reinstatement transmission today: none.
